mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM room r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT LR_RM_NUM, COUNT(*) AS reserved_count FROM lo_reservation WHERE LR_STATE = '예약완료' AND (LR_CHECKIN < #{checkout} AND LR_CHECKOUT > #{checkin}) GROUP BY LR_RM_NUM ) res ON r.RM_NUM = res.LR_RM_NUM WHERE r.RM_LD_NUM = #{ld_num} AND (r.RM_ROOMCOUNT - IFNULL(res.reserved_count, 0)) > 0 AND r.RM_PERSON >= #{person}
